item.title: ‘Settled 8 wars, including India-Pakistan’: Donald Trump at Davos 2026
item.description: At Davos, Trump claimed he “settled eight wars,” including a potential India-Pakistan conflict, while reiterating his controversial Greenland remarks. His bold statements have left world leaders and analysts debating US diplomacy and global influence.

item.title: Western disturbance to change weather across North India; Check weather report here
item.description: Weather conditions across North India are set to change on January 22 as an active western disturbance impacts the region. According to India Meteorological Department (IMD), rain and snowfall are likely in Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand.

item.title: Donald Trump softens stance on Greenland, withdraws tariff threat; Know why
item.description: US President Donald Trump has rolled back his proposed tariff threat against European countries amid tensions over Greenland. The decision came after a positive bilateral meeting with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte during the World Economic Forum.

item.title: ICC Vs BCB: Emergency meeting called in Dhaka; Will players’ views change the final decision?
item.description: Bangladesh cricket is facing uncertainty ahead of the T20 World Cup 2026 as the International Cricket Council has issued a final 24-hour ultimatum. The Bangladesh government has held emergency meetings with selected players and Bangladesh Cricket Board officials to decide whether the team will travel to India.

item.title: Indian markets rebound after three-day decline; Sensex surges, Nifty trades higher
item.description: Indian equity benchmarks opened sharply higher on Thursday, snapping a three-day losing streak. The NSE Nifty 50 opened above the 25,300 mark, while the BSE Sensex surged over 500 points in early trade.

item.title: Gold falls from record highs as geopolitical tensions ease; Silver slightly up
item.description: Gold prices fell in both international and domestic markets on Thursday after easing geopolitical tensions over Greenland boosted the US dollar.

item.title: Apple enters Indian digital payment market, launch expected this year; Here’s how it works
item.description: Apple is preparing to launch its digital payment service Apple Pay in India, aiming to enter one of the fastest-growing digital payments markets. The company is in talks with global card networks like Mastercard and Visa and seeking regulatory approvals.

item.title: Sajjan Kumar acquitted in 1984 anti-Sikh riots case by Delhi Court; Full details
item.description: Delhi’s Rouse Avenue Court on Thursday acquitted former Congress MP Sajjan Kumar in the 1984 anti-Sikh riots case linked to violence in Janakpuri and Vikaspuri.

item.title: Moradabad Horror: Sister and lover brutally murdered and buried; Gruesome details revealed
item.description: In Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, a young couple, Kajal and Armaan, were brutally murdered by Kajal’s brothers in an alleged honour killing. The bodies were buried behind Neem Karoli Baba temple after a two-year love affair between them.
